discovery.summary: Review Pennsylvania vendor entity and domain maturity
discovery.description: Resolve a supplied Pennsylvania company name to one unique strong Department of State legal entity, compare its formation age against minEntityAgeDays, verify the supplied domain through authoritative RDAP, require legal-name/domain alignment, and compare domain registration age against minDomainAgeDays. Returns established_vendor or human_review. Established history is a bounded maturity signal only and is not proof of legitimacy, safety, fraud risk, creditworthiness, ownership, authority, good standing, or legal compliance.
discovery.resource_description: Resolve a Pennsylvania vendor to a unique legal entity, compare entity formation age and legal-name-aligned authoritative domain registration age against caller thresholds, and return established_vendor or human_review. This is a maturity/history workflow signal, not proof of legitimacy, safety, fraud risk, creditworthiness, ownership, authority, or legal compliance.

buyer.task: Review whether a prospective Pennsylvania vendor has both an established legal-entity history and an established legal-name-aligned domain history before an automated workflow continues.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure independently verified external settled purchases and repeat demand; do not treat synthetic fixtures, public discovery or HTTP 200 as sales.

sources.authority: Pennsylvania Department of State via data.pa.gov
sources.refresh_policy: live lookup on each paid request

sources.authority: IANA DNS bootstrap plus authoritative registry RDAP
sources.refresh_policy: authoritative domain lookup on each paid request
sources.cache_policy: IANA bootstrap cached in memory for adapter lifetime; authoritative domain result not cached

rules: Require one strong unique PA entity with usable creation date at least minEntityAgeDays old.
Require authoritative RDAP registered domain aligned to resolved legal name and registered at least minDomainAgeDays ago.
Missing or young entity/domain records require human_review and do not establish fraud or safety.
established_vendor is a maturity/history workflow signal only
entity age does not establish current good standing, ownership, authority, legitimacy, creditworthiness, or legal compliance
domain age and legal-name alignment do not prove domain ownership or control
older entity/domain history is not proof a vendor is safe or trustworthy
recent entity or domain registration is a review signal, not proof of fraud

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; do not settle payment.

criteria: Existing exact-revision release gate and deterministic tests must pass before a reviewed deployment.
Independently verify authoritative-source availability, payment identity, and current facilitator fee/allowance terms.
Commercial release remains blocked until true hosting/source/refund economics and independently verified customer demand are established.
